Report of suspected attempt to assassinate
Mr. T.V. Soong.

The four accused were arraigned before the S.S.D.
Court at about 10 a.m. Jan 10, 1936, when Judge Feng
delivered the following judgment:-

1st accused Teng Ying Chai:- 2 years' imprisonment.
2nd " Wu Ah Zai:- 1 " "
3rd " Wei Sang Fong:- 2 " "
4th " Tsang Sih Ziang:- 2 " "

Two pistols, ammunition and magazines to be confiscated,
and the accused to be handed over to the representatives
of the Procurator's Office, Shanghai District Court for
inquiries.

As regards the wanted man Foo Fong Leh (傅方大)
alias Zung Ah Loh (张露禄) who is implicated in this
case as the person who was originally in touch with
certain unknown Japanese who were alleged to be conspiring
to attempt to take the life of Mr. T.V. Soong, a Circular
Order of Arrest will now be applied for at the S.S.D.
Court.

Commencing on October 16, 1935, precautionary
measures to ensure the safety of Mr. T.V.Soong upon his visits
to the Bank of China, usually between 10 a.m. and 1 p.m. daily,
were adopted by the Special Branch in conjunction with Central
Station. Between October 16 and December 31, 1935, one Chinese
detective from the Special Branch was detailed for this duty
and the total number of hours performed was 130.

Report of suspected attempt to assassinate
Mr. T.V.Soong.

At about 5 p.m. December 18, 1935, the following
copies of reports in this case were submitted to D.C.
(Crime) for consideration for handing over to Dr. Wong Wha
of the Public Safety Bureau: 2nd diary, statements of the
four accused and the two chauffeurs concerned, with initial
report of the 1st hire car and the two pistols found in
the 2nd hire car submitted by Hongkew Station.

In accordance with instructions received the under-
signed informed C.I. Mason, M.A.'s office, concerning the
further remand of the case and through A/M.A. Wong, the Charge
Sheet was presented at the S.S.D.Court on December 19, 1935
and the case was remanded until Friday, December 27, at
2 p.m. special hearing.

From 11.10 a.m. to 11.45 a.m. December 19, the
undersigned accompanied by C.D.S. 301 interviewed Mr.
Doo Yoch Sung, Chairman of the Chung Wei Bank, Avenue
Edward VII. In answer to the undersigned he stated as
follows, that he met the 3rd accused Wei Song Fong many
years ago when the 3rd accused was a Detective Inspector in
charge, Shanghai Public Safety Bureau and later Mr. Doo
recommended him for a post on the staff of Mr. Waung Ching
Wei and from that time did not actually meet the 3rd
accused again until 1932 when he heard from a very reliable
source that the 3rd accused was secretly working in the
pay of the Japanese Military Authorities in Shanghai.
During September 1935, the 3rd accused called on Mr. Doo
stating vaguely about information that certain Japanese
were planning to assassinate Mr. T.V.Soong. Mr. Doo did
not pay much attention to the 3rd accused at that time
believing that the matter could not be treated as serious.

关于涉嫌企图暗杀
宋子文先生的报告。

1935年12月18日下午5时左右，本案件的下列报告副本已提交给犯罪科总监（D.C. (Crime)），以供考虑移交给公共安全局的黄华博士（Dr. Wong Wha）：第二份日记、四名被告及两名相关司机的供词，以及虹口巡捕房提交的关于第一辆出租汽车的初步报告和在第二辆出租汽车中发现的两支手枪的报告。

根据收到的指示，署名者通知了总办办公室的梅森（Mason）首席督察有关案件进一步还押的事宜，并通过助理总办黄先生，于1935年12月19日在特区地方法院提交了起诉书，案件还押至12月27日星期五下午2时进行特别聆讯。

12月19日上午11时10分至11时45分，署名者会同华籍侦探警士301号会见了爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII，今中山东一路）中华汇业银行（Chung Wei Bank）董事长杜约松（Doo Yoch Sung）先生。针对署名者的提问，他陈述如下：他在多年前结识第三被告魏松芳（Wei Song Fong），当时第三被告担任上海公共安全局侦探督察长，后来杜先生推荐他在汪精卫（Waung Ching Wei）先生的幕僚中任职，从那时起直到1932年才再次实际见到第三被告，当时他从非常可靠的消息来源获悉，第三被告暗中受雇于驻上海的日本军事当局。1935年9月期间，第三被告拜访杜先生，含糊地提及有关某些日本人计划暗杀宋子文先生的情报。杜先生当时并未太在意第三被告，认为此事不必当真。

similar calls later on Mr. Doo and finally Mr. Doo came to
believe that the information may be reliable, especially
as the 3rd accused did not mention any reward or ask for

he had two very reliable followers working on the case,
and that the assassination was to be carried out at the
instigation of the Japanese in order that six and half
million dollars deposited in the Yokohama Specie Bank by
Mr. T.V.Soong could be confiscated after his death.
The 3rd accused was unable to give Mr. Doo any definite
information about the plot claiming that same was a very
closely guarded secret and thus any information was extremely
difficult to obtain. Mr. Doo, however, firmly warned the
3rd accused that he must be very careful how he made
inquiries as Mr. Doo would certainly not be responsible for
any work done by the 3rd accused or his followers in the
case, but as previously stated Mr. Doo agreed that if the
3rd accused obtained reliable information Mr. Doo was
quite willing to inform Mr. T.V.Soong on behalf of the 3rd
accused. After several days had passed Mr. Doo wondered why
the 3rd accused had failed to visit him and give any other
details, so Mr. Doo telephoned him on two or three occasions
when the 3rd accused claimedthat he was working on the case
very hard and therefore could not visit Mr. Doo, but the
3rd accused promised the information would follow later.

因为此类案件的谣言在上海不断流传。第三被告后来又拜访了杜先生约三次，最终杜先生开始相信该情报可能是可靠的，特别是因为第三被告在这些拜访期间从未提及任何报酬或要求费用。于是杜先生建议第三被告尝试获取更可靠的情报，杜先生承诺应第三被告的要求，将把情报转达给宋子文先生。第三被告在任何时候都未披露其线人的身份，但提到他有两名非常可靠的追随者正在处理此案，并且这次暗杀是在日本人的唆使下进行的，目的是在宋子文先生死后没收其存入横滨正金银行的六百五十万美元存款。第三被告无法向杜先生提供关于该阴谋的任何确切信息，声称这是一个保密极严的秘密，因此极难获取任何情报。然而，杜先生严厉警告第三被告，在进行调查时必须非常小心，因为杜先生绝不会对第三被告或其追随者在本案中进行的任何工作负责，但如前所述，杜先生同意如果第三被告获得可靠情报，他很乐意代表第三被告通知宋子文先生。几天过去了，杜先生纳闷为何第三被告没有来拜访他并提供其他细节，于是杜先生给他打了两三次电话，第三被告声称他正在全力处理此案，因此无法拜访杜先生，但第三被告承诺稍后会提供情报。

During the forenoon of November 22,1935, the 3rd
accused unexpectedly telephoned to Mr. Doo stating that
two Japanese and three Chinese were waiting in the
vicinity of the Customs House, Hankow Road near the Bank of
China, in hire car No. 18163 and they intended to shoot
Mr. T.V.Soong when he arrived at the bank. Mr. Doo
immediately had this information conveyed to Mr. T.V.Soong
in Nanking and Mr. Doo also told the 3rd accused at this
time that Mr. T.V.Soong was in Nanking, to which the 3rd
accused replied stating that the attempt would not be made
that morning as the assassins had found too many Police
officers in the vicinity and he promised to telephone
Mr. Doo again if another attempt was made.

During the forenoon of December 9, 1935, the
3rd accused arrived in a hurry at Mr. Doo's home about
10.45 a.m. and stated that the party of assassins had already
left by hire car Licence No. 17694, Chinese Lic. No.4455
and were expected to visit Hankow Road near The Bund as
on the previous occasion.

The 3rd accused was very excited and asked Mr. Doo
to quickly inform Mr. T.V.Soong accordingly, which Mr. Doo
then carried out over the telephone. During the evening
of the same date, Mr. T.V.Soong informed Mr. Doo. that the
Police had seized two pistols in the hire car as described,
and Mr. Doo then believed that the 3rd accused had given
reliable information. However the 3rd accused did not
visit Mr. Doo until the latter telephoned to him on the
following day and requested the 3rd accused to visit the
Bank on the following morning, December 11,1935.

The 3rd accused on arrival at about 10.30 a.m.
December 11 did not mention anything about the case

accused stated that he was not aware of the result of his
information, so Mr. Doo then told him that two pistols were

1935年11月22日上午，第三被告意外地打电话给杜先生，称有两名日本人和三名中国人正等候在靠近中国银行的海关大楼（汉口路）附近的一辆牌照号为18163的出租汽车内，他们打算在宋子文先生到达银行时开枪射击。杜先生立即将此情报转达给在南京的宋子文先生，杜先生此时也告诉第三被告宋子文先生身在南京，第三被告回答说，由于刺客发现附近警察太多，当天上午不会采取行动，他承诺如果再次有行动，会再打电话给杜先生。

1935年12月9日上午，第三被告匆忙来到杜先生家中，时间约为上午10时45分，并称刺客团伙已乘坐牌照号为17694、中国牌照号为4455的出租汽车离开，预计将像上次一样前往外滩附近的汉口路。

第三被告非常激动，要求杜先生迅速相应地通知宋子文先生，杜先生随即通过电话办理了此事。同日晚上，宋子文先生通知杜先生，警方已在所述的出租汽车中缴获两支手枪，杜先生由此相信第三被告提供了可靠的情报。然而，第三被告直到第二天杜先生给他打电话并要求他于次日即1935年12月11日上午来银行之前，一直没有拜访杜先生。

第三被告于12月11日上午10时30分左右到达时，只字未提案件情况，杜先生问他关于发现手枪的事。第三被告表示他不知道其情报的结果，于是杜先生告诉他有两支手枪被

found by the Police in the hire car but no arrests had
been made and suggested that the 3rd accused should try
hard to obtain more information in order to lead to the
arrest of the persons concerned. Since that time the
3rd accused did not visit or telephone Mr. Doo again.
On December 12 Mr. Doo received information from
Mr. T.V.Soong that four arrests had been made by the Police
and that the 3rd accused Wei Song Fong was one of the men
in custody. Mr. Doo stated he was very surprised and
later informed Mr. T.V.Soong that if the 3rd accused had
conspired together with the others in making a false
report with the intent to gain a reward for these services,
he should be charged.
The undersigned then asked Mr. Doo for his opinion
as to whether Japanese were really involved in such a plot
as described and Mr. Doo stated in reply that he now
believes that in view of the connection of the 3rd
accused with the Japanese in 1932 he felt that a plot was
made of which the 3rd accused was able to learn and he
made contact through an informer but later this informer
failed in some way to keep in touch with the case which
resulted in the 3rd accused arranging the planting of the
pistols and using hire cars in order to merely establish
himself in favour again with Mr. Doo, and not with the
object of gaining any monetary reward, as the 3rd accused
is at present unemployed.
It will be noted in this account of Mr. Doo that
it is corroborated by the statements of the 3rd accused
and others in custody and it appears that the 3rd accused
planned the case in order to gain favour as described,
however further inquiries are proceeding and will be made
the subject of a later report.
Enquiries by D.S.I. Tilton and C.D.S.301.

警方在租赁汽车内发现了（手枪），但未实施逮捕，并建议第三被告应努力获取更多信息，以便逮捕相关人员。自那时起，第三被告未再拜访或致电杜先生。
12月12日，杜先生从宋子文先生处获悉，警方已实施四次逮捕，且第三被告魏松芳（Wei Song Fong）是被拘留者之一。杜先生表示他非常惊讶，随后告知宋子文先生，如果第三被告与他人共谋制造虚假报告以图获取酬金，则应对其提出指控。
签署人随后询问杜先生，日本人是否真的参与了所述的此类阴谋，杜先生回答说，鉴于第三被告在1932年与日本人的联系，他现在相信确实存在一个阴谋，第三被告得以获悉该阴谋，并通过一名线人建立了联系，但后来这名线人以某种方式未能与该案保持联系，导致第三被告安排放置手枪并使用租赁汽车，这仅仅是为了重新获得杜先生的好感，而非为了获取任何金钱报酬，因为第三被告目前失业。
值得注意的是，杜先生的这一说法得到了第三被告及其他在押人员的陈述的佐证，看来第三被告策划此案是为了如所述那样博取好感，然而进一步的调查正在进行中，并将作为后续报告的主题。
由警司蒂尔顿（Tilton）及刑事侦缉处301号进行调查。

四名被告于1935年12月12日中午12点左右在冯法官主持的第二特区地方法院受审，当时他们被还押候审，直至1935年12月19日星期四下午2点开庭审理。上述听证会闭门进行，冯法官要求除负责此案的侦探外的所有工部局警务人员离开法庭。

第四被告在北四川路被捕，他的两名朋友于12月12日上午11点来到第三被告魏松芳家中拜访，寻找魏某，请求他帮助解决第四被告在中央巡捕房被拘留一事。这两人名叫杨东高（Lin Tung Keh），37岁，浙江谭家桥人，住北四川路北瓦登路43号；以及高永基（Koh Yung Kee），36岁，上海人，住北四川路杨发路东18号。他们于12月12日下午1点30分左右接受讯问后被释放，因为没有证据表明有必要拘留他们，也未获得任何将他们与此案联系起来的信息。

1935年12月12日中午12点左右，侦探长约翰·弗朗西斯·沙利文（John Francis Sullivan）将一名名叫梁道来（Liang Tao Loi）的男子带到本巡捕房，该男子51岁，福州人，受雇于拉斐特餐厅（The Lafayette Restaurant）。这名男子获准见这四名被告，但无法辨认出他们。该警官报告称，他获得了一些否定性信息。

第三被告魏松永（Wei Song Yong）于12月13日从牢房提解出来，对其家中的所有文件进行了检查，但无结果。他后来在接受讯问时陈述，那把日本“南部”手枪是他以60美元的价格从第四被告曾思祥（Tsang Sih Siang）处购买的。随后对后者进行了讯问，他承认于1936年11月期间以35美元的价格并从北平保安队的一名名叫杨木生（Yang Moh Sung）的军士那里购买了这把手枪及50发子弹。这些子弹也随同手枪以60美元的价格卖给了第三被告魏松永。

第四被告曾思祥提供给第三被告魏松芳的50发子弹以及日本“南部”手枪，仍有40发下落不明，截至目前尚未追踪到。12月14日，第三被告魏松芳被护送回家，试图寻找这40发子弹，但无结果，因为他声称将这些子弹藏在桌子抽屉里，现在侦探认为他的家庭成员能够将其藏匿。侦探讯问了所有家庭成员，他们否认拿走了子弹，但承认魏松芳曾将子弹带回家。

工部局警务处武器鉴定科对12月12日在第一被告邓英斋（Teng Ying Chai）家中发现的7发子弹进行了检查，结果显示，其中5发此前曾装入过一支军用型毛瑟手枪，另有2发符合留在牌照号为S.M.C. 17094的租赁汽车内的日本“南部”手枪。由于发现“南部”手枪的弹匣内有8发7.65毫米口径子弹，这表明50发子弹中有40发失踪。

第一被告邓英斋就5发毛瑟子弹接受了讯问，并声明这些子弹是旧的，是他以前在中国军队担任军官时使用的。

1932, but firmly denied ever working, or even knowing, any

As regards the statements of the four accused each
admits participating in the scheme as already suspected
and mentioned in earlier reports.

The 3rd accused Wei Song Feng is clearly the leader
while the others have all played an active parts. The 2nd
accused described in his statement how he met an informer
Foo Fung Lok (not arrested) about Sept. 20, 1935, when Foo
told him about a plot by certain Japanese to assassinate
Mr. T.V. Soong and that this information could be conveyed
to Mr. Foo Yuh Sung. Later the 2nd accused visited Mr.
Foo and reported the case to him explaining that the motive
of the intended assassination was that the Japanese planned
to confiscate six and half million dollars deposited

第三名被告魏松峰（Wei Song Feng）也就1933年11月17日发生在法租界拉斐德路（Rue Lafayette）1弄113号其住所的一起涉嫌纵火案接受了讯问，他承认获得了6,400美元的保险金。此案由法国警察进行调查，据收到的消息，魏的某些朋友向相关保险公司施压，迫使它们支付理赔款。他还就其可能与1932年教堂公民维持协会（Chapel Citizens' Maintenance Association）存在的联系受到讯问，但他坚决否认曾与该组织的任何人员共事，甚至认识他们。

关于四名被告的供词，每人都承认参与了此前报告中已怀疑并提及的阴谋。

第三名被告魏松峰显然是主谋，而其他人都发挥了积极作用。第二名被告在供词中描述了他如何于1935年9月20日左右遇见一名线人傅丰乐（Foo Fung Lok，音译，未被捕），当时傅告诉他有一些日本人策划刺杀宋子文先生（Mr. T.V. Soong），并且这一情报可以转达给傅玉笙先生（Mr. Foo Yuh Sung，音译）。随后，第二名被告拜访了傅先生并向他报告了此案，解释说预谋刺杀的动机是日本人计划没收宋子文先生存入横滨正金银行的六百五十万美元，该存款是通过中国银行一名姓“洪”的人办理的。迪伊先生（Mr. Dee，音译）要求第三名被告魏继续调查，而他则会通知宋子文先生。

四名被告与傅随后前往位于汉口路中国银行外的海关大楼，将装有手枪的手提箱留在车内。随后，第三名被告魏通过电话将汽车号码告知多伊先生（Mr. Doe，音译），但多伊先生告诉他宋子文先生在南京。第三名被告、第一名被告和第二名被告返回汉口路的海关大楼，取回了装着手枪的手提箱，并乘同一辆车回家。

12月9日，第三名被告陪同第四名被告和傅前往第一名被告的住所，第三名被告交给第四名被告4.00美元，指示他再次从虹口租赁一辆汽车。这次，手枪被藏在箱子里，并与卷轴一起放置，正如警方后来在车中发现的那样。第三名被告和第一名被告在汉口路海关大楼外等候，直到第四名被告到达，并将租赁汽车的号码（工部局牌照号17694）告知第三名被告。第三名被告立即去找多伊先生，请求他通知宋子文先生注意那辆特定的汽车。

第三名被告最后陈述称，多伊先生于12月11日将他召至中和银行，并告知他宋子文先生提到在那辆汽车中发现了所述的两把手枪。随后，第三名被告走访了第一名被告的住所，将这一事实告知了他。

A perusal of the other statements by the three
accused corroborates the account by the 3rd accused. It
will be noted that the cars were hired in the Hongkew Dis-
trict in order to give the appearance that Japanese were
really involved. As regards the Japanese "Nambu" pistol,
this appears comparatively a new weapon, and in very good
condition, which gives rise to doubt the statements of
the persons now detained by the S.P.S.B., especially the
length of time this pistol has been in their respective
possessions. It should be possible to trace this pistol
by the number but same may lead to complication with the
Japanese Authorities if attempted.

In order to complete enquiries into this case it will
be necessary to obtain further particulars of the connec-
tion with the pistol and the five men now detained at
Nantao, the undersigned therefore will request that a
further remand be obtained to enable these enquiries to
be made, and further enquiries respecting the accused.

查阅其他三名被告的供词证实了第三名被告的叙述。值得注意的是，汽车是在虹口区租赁的，目的是制造日本人真正卷入的假象。至于那把日本“南部”式手枪，这似乎是一件相对较新的武器，且状况良好，这就让人对目前被特别市局（S.P.S.B.）拘留的人员的供词产生怀疑，特别是关于这把手枪在他们各自手中持有时间的长短。理论上应该可以通过号码追踪到这把手枪，但如果尝试这样做，可能会引起与日本当局的复杂交涉。

Date December 5 1935.

Subject Precautionary Measures adopted on behalf of Mr. T.V.Soong.

Made by and Forwarded by C.D.I. Grubb

Commencing from October 16, 1935, following represen-
tations by Tseng Yung, Secretary to Mr. T.V. Soong, to the
D. C. (Crime) to the effect that the Chairman of the National
Economic Council's life was in danger, one Chinese detective
from the Special Branch and two from Central Station have
carried out observation duty between 10 a.m. and 1 p.m.
daily in the vicinity of the Bank of China, Hankow Road, as
a precautionary measure when this official visits his office.

Steps to ensure the safety of Mr. T.V.Soong are
being continued and in addition to the detectives, a uniformed
Chinese constable now performs duty outside the bank between
9.30 a.m. and 1.30 p.m. daily. The posting of a uniformed
man commenced on November 26. Apart from precautions taken
by the Municipal Police, four or five armed guards are posted
in and around the bank. Attached is a sketch plan, submitted
by the D.D.O."A", showing the positions of the men on this
duty.

Apprehension of an attempt on the life of this official
by fellow nationals is guarded against as far as possible by
an adequate staff of bodyguards. At the present time, however,
it is feared by those in close contact with Mr. T.V.Soong
that certain Japanese elements have designs on his life,
hence the reasons for the additional precautions.

事由：为宋子文先生采取的预防性措施。

由 C.D.I. Grubb 撰写并呈报

自1935年10月16日起，鉴于宋子文先生的秘书曾庸（Tseng Yung，音译）向副总监（刑事科）提出陈述，称全国经济委员会主席的生命受到威胁，作为预防措施，当该官员前往办公室时，每日上午10时至下午1时，由一名来自政治部的华籍侦探和两名来自中央捕房的华籍侦探在汉口路中国银行附近执行监视任务。

为确保宋子文先生安全的措施仍在继续，除侦探外，现有一名身着制服的华籍巡捕每日上午9时30分至下午1时30分在银行外执勤。部署身着制服人员的工作始于11月26日。除工部局警务处采取的预防措施外，银行内部及周边还部署了四至五名武装警卫。随函附上由助理总监“A”组提交的示意图，显示了执勤人员的位置。

针对同胞可能对该官员进行的暗杀企图，已通过配备充足的保镖队伍尽可能加以防范。然而，目前与宋子文先生接触密切的人士担心，某些日本势力正图谋其性命，此即采取额外预防措施的原因。
